cleared_by.what_changed: NOT THE DEVICE'S DEFECT — THE LOOP'S. The ground_loop process was started 2026-08-13 15:35:43 and commit ba50814 ("the big bang: 24 components drop one level into their rungs") moved cairn/base/probe.py -> cairn/tools/base/probe.py at 20:55 that evening. The daemon went on holding cairn.base.probe.Probe in sys.modules while discovery exec'd each probe file fresh, whose own import resolved to cairn.tools.base.probe.Probe — two distinct class objects with the same name, so isinstance() failed and the loop reported the self-refuting "PROBE is Probe, not a Probe". The two ImportError faces (constrain, orient) are the same staleness: they named symbols added to cairn.tools.chain.grammar after the process started. WHAT CHANGED: the stale process (pid 525485, 29h old) was stopped and the loop relaunched on current code as pid 658644. VERIFIED before clearing, through the loop's OWN discover(), not a bare import: this device's probe folder returns its probes with failures==[].
